title: The Toxic Avenger
blurb: Troma's gross-out superhero: the 1984 original, two sequels shot as one film, a fourth that ignores them, and a 2023 remake.

ta89b.t: The Toxic Avenger Part III: The Last Temptation of Toxie

groups.title: The original and its first two sequels
Citizen Toxie
groups.note: Follows the first film and ignores II and III.

note: Citizen Toxie follows the first film and says outright that parts II and III never happened. Parts II and III were shot as one film and split in two. The 2023 film is a remake.
